task: Add a new POST /payments/charges endpoint to the payment API. Prior context is large; token budget is critically constrained.

candidate_memories.content: All payment API endpoints must validate the X-Idempotency-Key header and reject requests without it to prevent duplicate charges. This check must occur in middleware before any route handler executes. Violations trigger an automatic compliance alert.
REST endpoints should follow kebab-case naming convention; use plural nouns.
New endpoints must be added to the OpenAPI spec in docs/api/openapi.yaml before deployment.
Developer asked about the naming convention for the new charge endpoint path.
